name: Hello, You
summary: Ask for a name and greet it. Your first Swift program.

files.main.swift:
// Tap ▶, then type in the box under the console.
import Foundation
setvbuf(stdout, nil, _IONBF, 0)   // show prompts right away

print("What's your name? ", terminator: "")
let typed = readLine()?.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces) ?? ""
let name = typed.isEmpty ? "friend" : typed

print("Hello, \(name)! Welcome to Swift.")
print("Your name has \(name.count) letters and backwards it's \(String(name.reversed())).")

files.main.swift:
import Foundation

let text = "  The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog  "
let clean = text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)

print("count:       \(clean.count) characters, \(clean.split(separator: " ").count) words")
print("upper/lower: \(clean.uppercased().prefix(9)) / \(clean.lowercased().prefix(9))")
print("contains:    fox? \(clean.contains("fox")), starts with The? \(clean.hasPrefix("The")), ends with dog? \(clean.hasSuffix("dog"))")
print("replace:     \(clean.replacingOccurrences(of: "lazy", with: "sleepy"))")
print("split/join:  \(clean.split(separator: " ").map { $0.capitalized }.joined(separator: "-"))")
print("reversed:    \(String(clean.reversed()))")

// Characters can be several bytes, so Swift uses indexes instead of numbers.
let word = "Mango 🥭 café"
print("\ncharacters:  \(word.count), bytes in UTF-8: \(word.utf8.count)")
print("first/last:  \(word.first!) \(word.last!)")
let start = word.index(word.startIndex, offsetBy: 6)
print("7th char:    \(word[start])")
print("first five:  \(word.prefix(5)), last four: \(word.suffix(4))")
if let space = word.firstIndex(of: " ") { print("up to space: \(word[..<space])") }
print("as an array: \(Array(word.prefix(5)))")

// Building and formatting.
let name = "Ada", score = 97.456
print("\ninterpolate: \(name) scored \(score.rounded()) (\(score > 90 ? "great" : "ok"))")
print("format:      " + String(format: "%.1f%%  |%5d|  |%-8.2f|  %03d", score, 42, 3.14159, 7))
print("padding:     [" + name.padding(toLength: 8, withPad: ".", startingAt: 0) + "]")
print("repeat:      " + String(repeating: "=-", count: 10))
print("multi-line:")
print("""
    Dear \(name),
      your score was \(Int(score)).
    """)

// Checking and converting.
print("numbers:     Int(\"42\") = \(Int("42") ?? 0), Double(\"3.5\") = \(Double("3.5") ?? 0), Int(\"x\") = \(String(describing: Int("x")))")
print("letters only? \("Swift".allSatisfy { $0.isLetter }), digits only? \("2024".allSatisfy { $0.isNumber })")
let vowels = clean.lowercased().filter { "aeiou".contains($0) }.count
print("vowels:      \(vowels)")
print("compare:     \("apple" < "banana"), same ignoring case? \("SWIFT".caseInsensitiveCompare("swift") == .orderedSame)")
print("palindrome:  \(["level", "swift"].map { "\($0)=\($0 == String($0.reversed()))" })")
